title: A deep learning approach for pricing convertible bonds with path-dependent reset and call provisions
abstract: arXiv:2605.12189v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper develops a deep learning framework for pricing convertible bonds with path-dependent downward reset and issuer call provisions governed by rolling-window triggers. We formulate the valuation problem as a path-dependent partial differential equation (PPDE) that captures both the historical stock-price path and the evolution of the conversion price. Model-specific PPDEs are derived under GBM, CEV, and Heston dynamics. Under suitable conditions, we establish the existence and uniqueness of a piecewise viscosity solution linked by contractual transmission conditions at monitoring dates. For computation, we construct a fixed-grid backward dynamic programming scheme and approximate its conditional expectations using neural networks, with $L^2$ convergence to the exact fixed-grid recursion as the approximation errors vanish. translated_title: 一种用于定价具有路径依赖重置和赎回条款的可转换债券的深度学习方法
translated_abstract: 本文开发了一个深度学习框架，用于定价具有路径依赖向下重置条款以及由滚动窗口触发机制约束的发行人赎回条款的可转换债券。我们将估值问题表述为一个路径依赖偏微分方程（PPDE），该方程同时刻画了历史股票价格路径和转股价的演变过程。在几何布朗运动（GBM）、常弹性方差（CEV）和Heston动力学模型下，我们推导了相应模型的PPDE。在适当条件下，我们建立了由监测日处的合同传递条件相连接的分段粘性解的存在性和唯一性。在计算方面，我们构建了一个固定网格的向后动态规划方案，并利用神经网络逼近其条件期望，当逼近误差趋于零时，该方案以L²范数收敛于精确的固定网格递推。将该框架应用于中信银行可转换债券的定价，三种模型均产生了稳定的价格，并且……
tldr: 本文提出一个基于路径依赖偏微分方程与神经网络逼近的深度学习框架，用于定价含路径依赖重置和赎回条款的可转换债券，并在理论证明了分段粘性解的存在唯一性的同时给出了具有收敛保证的计算方法。
en_tdlr: This paper develops a deep learning framework based on path-dependent PDEs and neural network approximations for pricing convertible bonds with path-dependent reset and call provisions, establishing existence and uniqueness of the piecewise viscosity solution along with a provably convergent numerical scheme.
